essence: The beloved is asked to explain the procedure of preliminary rites.
The mantra's success comes effortlessly for the beautiful one.
The sequence given is the ramā-seed, viśva-seed, and vadhū-seed.
The best practitioner should chant eight thousand times.
The sequence continues with kūrca-seed, śakti-seed, and then the kṣa-syllable.
